title: Boundary cube attachment for coherent rigidification
statement:
Use small simplicial categories and their colimits and the two-object category $U(K)$ of [lem-coef-simplicial-interval-lifting], and the subset-poset coherent realization $\mathfrak C$ of [lem-coef-pinched-cube-latching], in fixed universes enlarged when necessary. For $m\geq0$ put $B_m=(\Delta^1)^m$ and let $\partial B_m$ be the union of its coordinate faces $t_j=0$ and $t_j=1$; by convention $B_0=\Delta^0$ and $\partial B_0=\varnothing$. For every $n\geq1$, the canonical functor $\mathfrak C[\partial\Delta^n]\to\mathfrak C[\Delta^n]$ is injective on objects and mapping simplicial sets. Both object sets are $\{0,\ldots,n\}$. All mapping simplicial sets agree except the one from $0$ to $n$, where the functor is the inclusion $\partial B_{n-1}\hookrightarrow B_{n-1}$ under the characteristic-function identification of the subset poset with the cube. More precisely, the square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}U(\partial B_{n-1})&\longrightarrow&\mathfrak C[\partial\Delta^n]\\ \downarrow&&\downarrow\\ U(B_{n-1})&\longrightarrow&\mathfrak C[\Delta^n]\end{array}$$
is a pushout of simplicial categories, where the two objects of $U$ go to $0,n$ and the horizontal maps on their forward mapping simplicial sets are the displayed identifications. For $n=0$ the boundary functor is $\varnothing\to\{0\}$. No local Kan or model-structure hypothesis on a target category is required.
